purpose: Read-only cross-comparison of the frozen tested-source manifest against both completed Windows build input manifests.
comparisonMethod: Exact ordinal relative-path match; case-insensitive SHA-256 hexadecimal equality. Every tested-source row must occur with the same hash in each build input manifest. Duplicate paths are rejected. Input JSON files are SHA-256/length/last-write checked before and after reading.
limitations: This is evidence-file comparison, not a new Unity test, build or player execution.

The tested-source manifest contains 410 C# and assembly-definition files. The comparison establishes their inclusion and byte identity within each 3055-file build input manifest; it does not establish that every non-source build input was identical at test execution time.
Build input manifests include tracked, untracked and ignored project inputs. Additional build inputs beyond the frozen tested-source set are expected and are not treated as differences.
Matching endpoint hashes does not prove absence of transient edits, deterministic compilation, Library import-state identity, or runtime dependency inclusion.

The separately hashed source-to-binary receipts supply build provenance. This comparison does not independently rerun their BuildReport or output-binary checks and does not claim Windows campaign completion or visual quality.
Local-only audio, source provenance and build artifacts remain subject to the local-only music policy; no upload is performed.
